Opp. Party(s)
 ---
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajesh Kumar
---

For the Petitioner(s)/Applicant(s) : Mr. L.C. Roy, Adv.
 For the State : Mr. Arup Kr. Dey, A.P.P.
 ---
06/12.07.2024: Heard the parties.

2. The applicant, who is in custody since 07.02.2023, has renewed the prayer for grant of regular
bail in connection with Simariya P.S. Case No.24 of 2023 registered for the offence under Sections
342, 323, 376, 504 Ipc and Section 4 of the Pocso Act, pending in the court of learned P.D.J.,
Chatra.

3.  Earlier the prayer for bail of the applicant(s) has been rejected vide order dated 13.12.2023 passed in B.A. No.9983 of 2023.
4.

It has been submitted by the counsel for the applicant(s) that complete set of FIR/ Complaint Case along with its enclosure have been annexed with this bail application and there is no suppression on the part of the applicant(s).
5.
Innocence has been claimed and participation in the trial has been assured.
Referring to the statement of the mother of the victim-girl, it has been submitted that the girl was major at the time of commission of crime.
This applicant is in custody since 07.02.2023.
On the above facts, prayer for bail has been renewed.

6. On the other hand, learned A.P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail and it has been submitted that although in the medical examination, the girl has found major but the mother has also supported the factum of rape.
